credits.name: NBA betting data October 2007 to June 2024
credits.credit: Results, spreads, and moneylines through mid 2022-23 from the CC0 Kaggle file nba_2008-2026.csv.

credits.name: MGM Grand NBA betting data
credits.credit: BetMGM pregame moneylines, 2021-22 through 2026-02-12, used only where the CC0 file has no moneyline. CC BY-SA 4.0, Casey Durfee.

gaps: Primary moneylines stop during 2022-23. Later prices are BetMGM through 2026-02-12. No moneyline from 2026-02-13 onward (last completed game in this file: 2026-06-13).

Spread and total are nearly complete from 2007-08. The spread is the favorite's number of points, alongside whos_favored. There is no spread price in the CC0 file, so every ATS bet is graded at -110 (1.909).
Rows marked neither regular nor playoff (play-in and a handful of cup dates) are the phase 'other', not mixed into the regular season or the playoffs.

definitions.season: Season start year. 2007 means 2007-08. The source file stores the ending year; it is converted here.
definitions.phase: regular, playoff, or other. other is the source rows where both regular and playoffs are false.
definitions.moneyline: Flat 1.00 unit. Source is kaggle-cc0 when the CC0 file has a price, otherwise betmgm. NBA games do not tie. A missing price is not a bet.
definitions.ats: Home spread line is positive when home is favored. Cover rule matches the NFL rule. Price is always 1.909. Pushes are counted and excluded from ROI.
definitions.calibration: Same two-way de-vig, 5-point probability buckets, Brier score, and average overround as the NFL file.
definitions.sampleSize: played, bets, and pushes are separate.
